submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.884 ns across all tested configurations. This represents a significant performance advantage over the alternatives: it is 31% better than Mixture-G1's best performance (1.283 ns at 2mm) and 57% better than Mixture-G3's best performance (2.075 ns at 2mm). The 2mm gap also provides optimal performance for Mixture-G2 compared to 1mm (1.019 ns) and 3mm (1.041 ns) configurations. This configuration directly satisfies the primary goal of achieving the best possible time resolution while meeting all constraints.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 at 2mm gap achieves 0.884 ns time resolution, which is the best performance among all nine tested configurations (G1/G2/G3 at 1/2/3mm gaps)

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 is one of the three candidate mixtures identified and evaluated in the simulation
Recommended gap of 2mm is within the required range of 1-3mm

requirements.requirement: The gas system must comply with the laboratory's environmental and safety policies
requirements.evidence: All three candidate mixtures were pre-screened for compliance with laboratory policies, as indicated by their inclusion in the candidate specifications
